• 1. Form 3 of Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure scheme will be enabled shortly

  • 3. Form 1 under the “Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme” is now available for filing.

Meet our founder

Driven by purpose.

Guided by experience.

Vibha Gupta founded Tax Swami with a simple belief: professional financial and legal guidance should be clear, accessible, and practical. With experience across taxation, litigation, finance, and corporate law, the approach focuses on understanding each situation thoroughly and providing clear, considered, and actionable advice. A highly qualified and experienced finance professional with over 15 years of expertise in the fields of audit and tax, Vibha Gupta is a Fellow Chartered Accountant (FCA), having cleared her Chartered Accountancy in 2012. At Tax Swami, this philosophy extends to a multidisciplinary team with expertise in taxation, accounting, legal advisory, compliance, transfer pricing and business consulting. By bringing these perspectives together, we help individuals and businesses navigate complex financial, legal, and regulatory matters with greater clarity and confidence.
